releaseNotes: v1.3.6 -- Fixed a discovery-page bug where unchecking an existing device on a standalone (single-channel) source never removed it. Also relabeled the multi-channel apply toggle and device rows for clarity, and reworded the source-removal toggle to spell out its scope. v1.3.5 -- Capability-detection corrections cross-checked against Reolink's officially-backed reolink_aio library: split the doorbell status/ring LED into its own 'Status LED' feature (was mis-mapped to Spotlight), added a 'Night Vision' feature, added floodLight as a defensive Spotlight fallback, ability lookups now check both 'permit' and 'ver', and confirmed the real battery percentage field name.
author: jdthomas24
